name: Omenport
description: A town on Thunder Junction built around an Omenpath, with a half-built relay tower.

timeline.summary: Archie waits for an hour in Omenport until a masked stranger from another plane arrives through the Omenpath and hands him a burlap sack.
timeline.quote: In his outstretched fist was a burlap sack.

timeline.summary: Kellan works at the half-built relay tower in Omenport and reflects on the Omenpath that brought him from Eldraine.
timeline.quote: It was hard to believe it had only been a few weeks since he'd stepped through the portal.

timeline.summary: A technician's fault sends lightning through the relay tower and a worker falls from the scaffolding.
timeline.quote: From the height of the tower, the man fell.

timeline.summary: Kellan flies up on golden dust and catches the falling worker midair.
timeline.quote: Golden dust burst from his feet as he flew toward the man and wrapped his arms around him midair

timeline.summary: Ral dismisses the accident and walks away without looking at the fallen worker.
timeline.quote: He marched away without another glance toward the fallen worker.

timeline.summary: Kellan tells the worker that Ezrim told him his father was on this plane and that he is looking for him.
timeline.quote: My last boss, Ezrim—he told me my dad was on this plane.

timeline.summary: The overseer reassigns Kellan to Ral's security detail for a trip to Sterling Company headquarters in Prosperity.
timeline.quote: Mr. Zarek thinks someone with your skillset should be on his security detail instead of working out here in the heat.

timeline.summary: Kellan hopes someone in Prosperity can tell him about Oko and resolves to meet his father.
timeline.quote: The odds of at least someone in the city having information about Oko were bound to be high.

pages_say.description: A town on Thunder Junction built around an Omenpath, with a half-built relay tower.
The first city a traveler sees on Thunder Junction, where Yuma arrived.
The town where people come searching for the vault.
A city that offers high-collar marks for thieves.
